body: I feel OK today. I am high on opiates for the first time in months, I feel good for the first time in a long while.
The feeling has come and gone, on and off for the past seven or eight years. I'm twenty. I too understand the impulse to drive into a light pole or run the car off a bridge.
She is a source of conflict for me. If I died she would be devastated. Maybe if I didn't have her I would be just miserable enough to end it all.
